subject: [PATCH v5 11/15] SUNRPC: check rpc_sockaddr2uaddr() for failure when registering

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the SUNRPC code by checking if rpc_sockaddr2uaddr() returns NULL due to memory allocation failure, and returning -ENOMEM instead of proceeding with potentially invalid operations. This ensures that the universal address is properly checked for validity before being used. The fix addresses an issue introduced by a previous commit that removed duplicate universal address generation.
